title: UN Office of the Special Envoy for the Great Lakes Region: Political Affairs intern (Nairobi)
organization: United Nations Secretariat, Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for the Great Lakes Region (OSESG-GL)
overview: A 3 to 6 month unpaid internship in the Political Affairs Unit of the UN Special Envoy's office covering the Great Lakes region (which includes the DRC), based in Nairobi. Open to final-year bachelor's students and to master's students or graduates; English and working French required.
